description: This file contains the implementation of a SambaNova language model service that interacts with SambaNova's API using an OpenAI-compatible interface. It defines a class `SambaNovaLLMService` which extends `OpenAILLMService`, providing methods to initialize the service, create a client, build request parameters, and process streaming chat completion responses, including handling function calls and text frames.
